mass.allLaterEnvelope: E_id,sched(y,0)^2 <= P*^2 exp(-2/5) exp(-(y-1))/(1-rho_o)^2 for every y>=1
mass.proof: On 0<=y<=1, 0<=integral_0^y sigma<=y and E=P*exp(y/10-(3/5)integral sigma). Step symmetry gives integral_0^1 sigma=1/2. Every later constant/transition segment has l<=0 before the terminal collar, and the collar multiplies the reference exponential by at most 1/(1-rho_o). Integrating the two infinite exponential envelopes gives the stated finite bound.
